Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views

Class RibbonItem

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.views.RibbonItem
public final class RibbonItem extends Object
One ribbon (toolbar) entry above a table.

The ribbon runtime (juneau-ribbon.js) implements every behavior; this type only names it and carries its parameters. toMap() produces the same {type, ...} entry the runtime reads from viewDef.ribbon.

Setters are not gated per item type, but toMap() fails loudly rather than emit a key the runtime ignores for that type (for example form on a refresh, or symbol on an optionGroup), and checks the invariants the runtime cannot: a top-level option needs column or param (exactly one) plus a value, and a group's default must name a member. Group members take only id, title, symbol, column, param and value.

Example:

table.ribbon( RibbonItem.collapseAll(), RibbonItem.export("copy", "csv").optional("excel", "pdf"), RibbonItem.option("dropped-only").title("Dropped only").column("status").value("$eq(DROPPED)").persist(true), RibbonItem.optionGroup("phase", RibbonItem.option("pending").column("phase").value("$in(Waiting)"), RibbonItem.option("done").column("phase").value("$in(Completed)") ).defaultOption("pending"), RibbonItem.dialog("add").title("Add repo").form("/rest/skill-repos/add-modal") .endpoint("/rest/skill-repos/new").method(RowAction.Method.POST) .onSuccess(RowAction.OnSuccess.REDRAW), RibbonItem.refresh()); RibbonItem.refresh().title("Refresh tasks").target("tasks"); RibbonItem.publish("Focus east", "app.region-picked", Map.of("region", "east"));

Since:
10.0.0

    • export

      public static RibbonItem export(String... buttons)
      The ribbon's export menu, offering the named buttons.

      A button here is required: if its library is missing at runtime (JSZip for excel, pdfMake for pdf) it renders disabled and logs an error. Use optional(String...) for buttons that should simply be omitted when their library is absent. The menu may consist of optional buttons alone, but toMap() rejects one with no buttons at all.

      Parameters:
      buttons - The required buttons, each one of copy, csv, print, excel or pdf.
      Returns:
      A new RibbonItem.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If buttons names a button not in that set.

    • optionGroup

      public static RibbonItem optionGroup(String id, RibbonItem... members)
      A group of mutually exclusive option toggles.

      A member may omit column/param/value; selecting it then applies no filter (an "All" member).

      Parameters:
      id - The group's stable id. Must not be null or blank.
      members - The members, each created by option(String). Must not be empty.
      Returns:
      A new RibbonItem.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If id is null or blank, or members is empty or holds anything other than an option.

    • publish

      public static RibbonItem publish(String title, String topic, Map<String,Object> payload)
      A ribbon button that publishes a message when clicked. The topic must be a custom topic declared in the page's topics or a card's publishes, or cmd:<cardId>; the console's wiring check enforces that. Rendered only on a console page (no bus, no button).
      Parameters:
      title - The button label.
      topic - The topic to publish.
      payload - A JSON-serializable payload, or null for {}.
      Returns:
      A new RibbonItem.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If title or topic is null or blank.

    • target

      public RibbonItem target(String cardId)
      Sends this item's command to another card instead of its own table. Accepted on refresh, collapseAll, pausePolling, option and optionGroup; toMap() rejects it elsewhere.

    • visibleWhen

      public RibbonItem visibleWhen(VisibilityRule... rules)

      This object.

    • id

      public RibbonItem id(String v)
      Sets this item's stable id.

      The id is emitted on the item's ribbon entry, where it is scoped to its card (it is not stamped as a DOM id). toMap() rejects an id on the types the runtime ignores it for (divider and export).

      Parameters:
      v - The id. Must not be null or blank.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If v is null or blank.

    • toMap

      public JsonMap toMap()
      Builds this item's ribbon entry.
      Returns:
      The entry, type first, then only the keys that were set.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the item sets a key the runtime ignores for its type, a top-level option sets neither or both of column and param or no value, an export has no buttons, or a default does not suit the item (an option takes defaultOn(); an optionGroup takes defaultOption(String) naming a member), or a target is set on a type the runtime does not route.

    • validate

      public static void validate(Map<?,?> item)
      Validates an authored ribbon item map (for example from a JSON5 card body) with exactly the rules toMap() applies to a built item: a known type, only keys the runtime reads, an export with at least one valid button, an option with exactly one of column or param plus a value, a default that suits the item, a valid appearance and target, a well-formed visibleWhen (a list of field/op rules with a known op), and the same rules for each optionGroup member.
      Parameters:
      item - The authored item. Must not be null.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the item is not valid.
